ops: repo-memory: Read/Write/Glob/Edit tools ONLY (Bash/Grep on /tmp blocked - use Glob with explicit path for enumeration). Bash works fine for gh/git in the repo working dir. After Write, `safeoutputs push_repo_memory` to validate. TOTAL memory must be <=12KB (10KB patch limit) - keep lean, stub/trim old entries every run rather than letting state.json grow unbounded.

create issue (WORKING RECIPE): Write tool -> eslint-factory/.tmp_issue_body.md (repo working dir only, NOT /tmp/gh-aw/*). `jq -Rs '{title:"...", body:., labels:["eslint","eslint-factory"]}' eslint-factory/.tmp_issue_body.md > eslint-factory/.tmp_issue.json`. `safeoutputs create_issue . < eslint-factory/.tmp_issue.json`. rm both temp files, confirm `git status --short eslint-factory/` clean.

dedupe: `gh api "repos/github/gh-aw/issues?state=open&per_page=100&labels=eslint-factory" --jq '.[] | {number,title}'` (query-string form works, -f form 403s). Newly-filed issues via safeoutputs do NOT appear in this query same-run. `gh api repos/github/gh-aw/issues/<n> --jq '{state,state_reason,closed_at,created_at}'` reflects already-applied history even for self-filed issues.

Shallow clone: git log/blame on eslint-factory/src/rules attributes all files to one squash commit - unusable for rule age. ruleCount bump is the reliable novelty signal - check FIRST every run. A HEAD move touching actions/setup/js can still be docs-only - check actual file list (`git show --stat`), not just insertion count, before treating it as a feature signal.

eslint-factory: NO node_modules/dist, npm firewalled - no live lint. Ground statically via Grep on non-test .cjs (config ignores *.test.cjs) + rule src/tests. Rules registered gh-aw-custom/<name>; all warn except require-http-response-error-listener (error). Check for existing eslint-disable-next-line comments before concluding a hypothesis is ungrounded.
create_discussion params: title*, body*, category, integrity, secrecy.
A rule's own .test.ts file is authoritative for known/intended limitations vs undiscovered bugs - always check it before filing.

Issues auto-expire (~1wk TTL), bot-closed not_planned. A single expiry is not reliably 'unfixed'. Always re-read current rule source before refiling. After 2 expiries of the same theme with no source change, retire it. Exception: #64416 closed same-day completed (genuine fast fix) - always check state_reason via `gh api issues/<n>` before assuming an expiry was unfixed housekeeping.

Bash sandbox flags multi-command chains/xargs/sort/printf-newlines/some grep -E as 'expansion' - prefer Grep/Glob/Read for exploration, reserve Bash for single simple gh/git one-liners. Grep tool rejects lookaround - use character-class negation instead.

Discovery priority: (1) ruleCount bump or confirmed-genuine new-feature commit (verify via file-list) - check first every run; (2) re-grep previously 'zero live call sites' rules against current corpus - demoted to lowest priority once a rotation has 2 clean passes.
